list.name: sites
list.label: Sucursales
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites WHERE status = 'operational' ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Visitantes
panels.description: Suma de personas que entraron al local en el período seleccionado, sumando todas las sucursales filtradas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(ins) AS "Visitantes" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de conversión
panels.description: Promedio ponderado del cociente compradores / visitantes. Requiere que la sucursal envíe transacciones POS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(visits), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM conversion_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Facturación
panels.description: Suma de ventas menos devoluciones en el período. Expresado en pesos argentinos (la unidad menor de la moneda dividida por 100).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(amount_minor_sale - amount_minor_return) / 100.0 AS "Facturación" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ticket promedio
panels.description: Facturación neta dividida por la cantidad de compradores (excluye devoluciones del denominador).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, (SUM(amount_minor_sale) - SUM(amount_minor_return))::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) / 100.0 AS "Ticket promedio" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Unidades por ticket
panels.description: Unidades vendidas ÷ compradores (UPT) del total de sucursales seleccionadas: cuántas prendas se lleva en promedio cada comprador.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(items_sale)::float/NULLIF(SUM(sales),0) AS "UPT" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Embudo de conversión
panels.description: Embudo: tráfico externo → cercano → visitantes → compradores, cada etapa como % del tope (tráfico externo = 100%). Pasá el mouse para ver la cantidad absoluta de cada etapa.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(w.passersby) ext, SUM(w.shoppers) cer, SUM(c.ins) vis, SUM(p.sales) comp FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id=w.store_id AND c.bucket_day=w.bucket_day FULL OUTER JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON COALESCE(c.store_id,w.store_id)=p.store_id AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day,w.bucket_day)=p.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id,w.store_id,p.store_id) IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day,w.bucket_day,p.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date) SELECT 'Tráfico externo' AS "Etapa", ext::float/NULLIF(ext,0) AS "% del tope", to_char(ext,'FM999,999,999') AS "Cantidad", 1 ord FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'Tráfico cercano', cer::float/NULLIF(ext,0), to_char(cer,'FM999,999,999'), 2 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'Visitantes', vis::float/NULLIF(ext,0), to_char(vis,'FM999,999,999'), 3 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'Compradores', comp::float/NULLIF(ext,0), to_char(comp,'FM999,999,999'), 4 FROM t ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Embudo por día (externo → compradores)
panels.description: Las 4 etapas del embudo por día: tráfico externo, tráfico cercano, visitantes y compradores. Mismos colores que el panel Embudo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day, p.bucket_day), 'DD/MM') AS "Día", SUM(w.passersby) AS "Tráfico externo", SUM(w.shoppers) AS "Tráfico cercano", SUM(c.ins) AS "Visitantes", SUM(p.sales) AS "Compradores" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id = w.store_id AND c.bucket_day = w.bucket_day FULL OUTER JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id) = p.store_id AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) = p.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id, p.store_id) IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day, p.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day, p.bucket_day) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day, p.bucket_day)

panels.title: Top 5 sucursales por conversión
panels.description: Las 5 sucursales con mayor tasa de conversión (compradores ÷ visitantes) en el período.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.store_name AS "Sucursal", SUM(p.sales)::float/NULLIF(SUM(c.ins),0) AS "Conversión" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id=p.store_id AND c.bucket_day=p.bucket_day WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY s.store_name HAVING SUM(c.ins)>0 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Facturación por día
panels.description: Facturación neta diaria (ventas − devoluciones) del total de sucursales seleccionadas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(bucket_day, 'DD/MM') AS "Día", SUM(amount_minor_sale - amount_minor_return)/100.0 AS "Facturación" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY bucket_day

panels.title: Hora más ocupada
panels.description: La hora del día con mayor ocupación promedio (personas dentro del local), agregado de las sucursales seleccionadas. Útil para planificar staff.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(hora::text,2,'0')||':00' AS "Hora" FROM (SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hora, AVG(avg_occupancy) occ FROM occupancy_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY hora ORDER BY occ DESC LIMIT 1) t

target.rawSql: SELECT (holiday_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, name AS text FROM holidays WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY holiday_date
